messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert (SEV2) — Increased 502 rates observed from APAC egress checks. Synthetic failure rate 18% over last 3m. Source: edge-health/apac-egress. Auto-paged: @maya (oncall)

maya: Ack. Looking. Any recent changes to egress routing or DNS weights?

alex: I pushed a weighted egress change as part of canary earlier today (feature/egress-weight). It should have been a partial 10% weight to apac-edge-v2. Deployed ~20m ago.

sanjay: Do we have graphs? APAC LB 502 spike corresponds with higher 503/504 from upstream or DNS flop?

ops-bot: Perf dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/apac-egress/egress-health  (spike chart pinned)

alex: From my quick look, upstream seems healthy. But our regional weight table shows apac-edge-v2 at 65% for a subset of prefixes — that doesn't match the intended 10%. Possible config propagation bug in the routing control plane.

maya: If weights drifted up, that explains overload and increased 502s from a few instances. Can we flip the feature flag / kill-switch for the egress weight? Runbook suggests kill the feature first. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/egress-weight-drift

sanjay: Agree. Two mitigation paths: 1) flip LD flag to force old weight (fast) 2) rollback the rollout to previous route config (slower but complete). I'd do (1) then (2) if it doesn't stabilize.

alex: LD key is `egress_weighting.v2_canary` — toggling to `false` should restore previous behavior.

maya: Executing kill-switch now (calling LaunchDarkly API):
```
# toggling canary off
curl -X POST "https://ld.redwood/api/toggles/egress_weighting.v2_canary/off" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${LD_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

maya: CLI output: `{"status":"ok","effective_state":"off","changed_by":"maya"}` :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Noted. Traffic starting to rebalance. APAC 502 rate dropping from 18% -> 7% in the last 90s.

support-bot: Customer impact report queueing — 14 unique customer request IDs touched (potentially affected). Creating incident ticket under INC-2314.

alex: Good. After kill-switch we should still roll back the routing commit to avoid repeated flapping. I'll prepare the rollback PR and request the automated rollback.

deploy-bot: Detected recent deploy: `route-service@prod` rev `r_2026_03_15_18` by alex. Rollback options: `--rollback-to r_2026_03_15_17` or `--abandon-canary`.

maya: Triggering rollback to r_2026_03_15_17 now. Command: 
```
./deploy rollback --service route-service --to r_2026_03_15_17 --reason "egress weight drift causing 502s APAC" --who maya
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued. Job ID: job-89234. Will post updates here.

deploy-bot: Rollback started on 3 nodes, progressing.

ops-bot: Post-rollback healthcheck shows APAC 502 rate down to 2.1% and p99 latency back within SLO.

maya: Great — looks stable. We'll keep the kill-switch in place until we validate the root cause and fix the control-plane propagation.

alex: I'll own the follow-up. Immediate next steps:
- Root cause analysis for config propagation (control plane + eventual consistency)
- Recreate the issue in staging with larger weight to validate fix
- Improve monitoring / alert rule to detect weight drift earlier (add cross-check between intended weights and actual live table)

sanjay: Assigning postmortem to alex. Please include timeline, steps to reproduce, and a mitigation playbook update (automate a weight diff check).

maya: For now: incident status = mitigated, paging suppressed. Will keep channel open for 30m for stability watch.

support-bot: Customer impact: 12 customers showed elevated error rates; no major revenue customers reported outages. Draft notification: "We experienced elevated API errors for a subset of APAC traffic due to a routing rollout. We mitigated by disabling the canary and rolling back the route config. Our teams are investigating and will follow up." — I'll draft and send after ops review.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll file the postmortem and schedule a follow-up with Networking and Control Plane teams.

maya: :thumbsup: Closing watch window at +30m if no regressions.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2314 created. Severity: SEV2. Owner: alex.
